title: High School Tech Internship Program
sponsor: Ohio Governor's Office of Workforce Transformation
pay_text: At least $12 per hour for internships the state reimburses
who_text: Ohio high school students interested in technology jobs
description: You work a paid internship at an Ohio employer in a tech role such as software, data, or cybersecurity. The state pays back part of your wages to the employer. To join, contact the regional organization for your part of Ohio listed on the page.

title: Ohio State Highway Patrol Cadet Internship
who_text: College freshmen (after one semester), sophomores, and juniors who are at least 18, keep a 2.5 GPA, and live in or move to Ohio
description: You work 10 to 20 hours a week at a State Highway Patrol post while you are in college, learning about law enforcement with a mentor. The program prepares you to become a State Trooper cadet later.
